# Gemma 7B (base)

Google · released 2024-02 · 8.54B params · gemma

**score 33.9** ±0.6 · #463 of 549 · from 30 benchmark results across 6 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-7b/blob/ff6768d9368919a1f025a54f9f5aa0ee591730bb/README.md): Context length stated on the official model card.</sub>

<pre>
download        size  score
4-bit q4_k_m  ~5.5GB   33.9
8-bit q8_0    ~9.1GB   33.9
</pre>

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m
ollama run gemma:7b-text-q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run gemma:7b-text-q8_0
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
